how_to_reproduce: Run 'Ingest Corpus' once, then run 'Test Suite Trigger'. No vector database credentials are required: the demo uses the in-memory Simple Vector Store with OpenAI embeddings through the n8n AI Gateway.
note: R03 and R04 ask the SAME question with different audiences. That pairing is what makes the access-control result meaningful: proving a document is blocked only means something if you also prove it would otherwise have been returned.

cases.answer: Northwind Outdoors accepts returns within 45 days of delivery for a full refund [C1]. This is provided the item is unworn and in its original packaging [C1].

cases.detail: Passages were retrieved but the model reported they do not answer the question, and that was passed through rather than dressed up as an answer.
OPS-210 contains the answer but is marked audience=internal, so it was removed before the model ever saw it.
cases.latency_note: This case took 63 s. The outlier is provider-side latency on the entailment judge, not retrieval; retrieval completed in well under a second in every case.

cases.answer: The Adelaide warehouse despatch cut-off is 2pm ACST Monday to Friday [C1]. During peak season from 20 November to 24 December, the cut-off is extended to 4pm ACST [C1].
The HydroSeal membrane is rated to 20,000 mm hydrostatic head [C1].

regression_history.cause: Every retrieval returned zero documents. The root cause was the embedding model, not the retrieval logic: the n8n AI Gateway returns HTTP 404 for gemini-embedding-001. Switching both embedding sub-nodes to OpenAI text-embedding-3-small fixed it.
